logp.method_description: The hydrophobicity values of cobalt(III) complexes 1–4 were determined by the ‘‘Shake flask’’ method in octanol–water phase partitions.7 A small amount of each complex was dissolved in a mixture of water and n-octanol (1 : 1, 10 mL) followed by shaking for 1 hour. After allowing 30 min for the mixture to settle, the resulting two phases were collected separately without cross contamination of one solvent layer by another. By using UV-Vis absorption spectroscopy, the concentration of the cobalt(III) complex in each phase was determined and three independent experiments were performed so as to present the results as the mean values. The hydrophobicity values of cobalt(III) complexes (1–4) were compared in terms of partition coefficient (log P) values using the following equation: logP = log([Complex]octanol / [Complex]water)
